01-last-light.jpg.title: Last light
01-last-light.jpg.alt: The sun low over a calm sea at dusk, its reflection broken into streaks on the water.

02-ridgelines.jpg.title: Ridgelines
02-ridgelines.jpg.alt: Seven mountain ridges receding into blue haze, each paler than the one in front.

03-night-market.jpg.title: Night market
03-night-market.jpg.alt: Soft, out-of-focus discs of orange, red and blue light against a dark street.

04-window-light.jpg.title: Four o’clock
04-window-light.jpg.alt: A window casts four slanted panes of warm afternoon light onto a bare wall above a dark floor.

05-dunes.jpg.title: Dunes
05-dunes.jpg.alt: Sand dunes in low sun, one side of each crest bright orange and the other in deep brown shadow.

06-pines-in-fog.jpg.title: Pines in fog
06-pines-in-fog.jpg.alt: Dark pine trunks in the foreground fade to pale grey shapes in thick fog behind them.

07-facade.jpg.title: Facade
07-facade.jpg.alt: A cream apartment block seen straight on: a grid of dark windows, a few lit yellow, crossed by a diagonal shadow.

08-long-road.jpg.title: Long road
08-long-road.jpg.alt: An empty two-lane road runs dead straight across flat country to a low sun on the horizon.

09-blue-hour.jpg.title: Blue hour
09-blue-hour.jpg.alt: A city skyline in silhouette under a deep blue evening sky, scattered windows lit and reflected in the water below.

10-waxing-moon.jpg.title: Waxing moon
10-waxing-moon.jpg.alt: A bright gibbous moon with grey craters, one edge falling into shadow, on a black sky dotted with stars.

11-red-door.jpg.title: Red door
11-red-door.jpg.alt: A vermilion door set in a teal wall, with a pale stone step and a long shadow falling across the pavement.

12-shoreline.jpg.title: Shoreline
12-shoreline.jpg.alt: Seen from above: turquoise sea meets pale sand along a line of white surf, with small coloured beach umbrellas scattered on the sand.
